messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-08-07, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- At the Boreal standup on 2025-11-03, it was decided that the webhook dispatcher will sign payloads with rotating keys. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03]
- The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- At the Cinder standup on 2026-01-30, it was decided that authentication gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- On 2026-04-08, the Atlas team observed that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
- On 2025-11-04, the Ember team observed that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-04]
- On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]
- On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- On 2025-12-31, the Atlas team observed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- On 2026-04-16, the Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- Authentication gateway token expiry was shortened to 15 minutes because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens. [valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- Tomasz was on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03, but left it on 2025-07-30 when he moved to the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is back on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Tomasz had the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team but is off rotation as of 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
    earlier: Tomasz has the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-02-12; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- On 2026-03-17, the Atlas team decided that the image resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team decided that the bus will retain messages for seven days, because replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. [decision; valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- Follow-up decision from the INC-2026-003 review: the webhook dispatcher will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [decision; valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
